name: @etzhayyim/gov-kotoba
description: kotoba reference implementation of the gov PUBLIC reference layer (agencies + public officials + municipalities) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS. Mixed split: citizen consultations (potential healthcare/welfare PII) stay etzhayyim (consent-capability); only public government open-data is etzhayyim-front. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000 + ADR-2606011400.
